metadata.title: The Well-Tempered clAIvier
metadata.subtitle: Fugue VI in D minor (a 4)
metadata.composer: Claude / Sam (ground after J. S. Bach, Crucifixus BWV 232)
metadata.tempo_text: Passacaglia e fuga sopra il Crucifixus. Grave, ma sempre in moto

markers.label: Station I (D minor): the ground in the Bass
Inversus = the ground at double speed (Alto)
Station II (A minor): the ground in the Tenor; the Bass rests
Episode 1: falling fifths to F major
Station III (F major): the ground in the Alto; the Soprano rests
Inversus (Bass), in tenths under the ground
Episode 2: the surface quickens (sixteenths), through G minor
Stretto: subject (Tenor) and answer (Alto), one bar apart
Summit: the ground augmented in the Bass; inversus (Tenor)
Ground in the Soprano (at the dominant): two speeds in the outer voices
Inversus (Tenor): the ground at three speeds at once
Coda: the subject augmented (Soprano) over the tonic

subject_entries.label: Inversus (Alto): the ground at double speed
Ground (Soprano), at the dominant, over its augmentation
